title: justicia leptantha
intro: Justicia leptantha, commonly known as the Blue Justicia, is a flowering plant species in the Acanthaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions like reducing fever, relieving cough, and soothing digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Justicia leptantha include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
